provenance: Hand-built. The coded rows are ICD-9-CM codes and their public D_ICD_DIAGNOSES long titles, chosen because they are among the most frequently assigned codes in adult critical care. No MIMIC-III record contributed to this file. The extracted strings are how a clinician or a patient would name the same condition in speech. Cases marked 'known-hard' are expected to fail: a fixture the instrument scores 1.0 on measures nothing.
